description: Akwadra lets users create, inspect, edit, validate, and preview web-app projects from ChatGPT. ChatGPT writes the source files while Akwadra stores them in the signed-in user’s private workspace. The plugin can also read build logs for already-hosted projects. It does not purchase hosting or process payments.

defaultPrompt: Create a complete responsive landing page for my business and save it as a new project.
Update my existing project with the changes I describe, then validate the files.
Show me the latest build status and errors for my hosted project.
